zh.title: SkyWest 將 CRJ200 改為41座 CRJ450 首架預計年底前投入聯航支線
zh.summary: SkyWest 計畫於2028年前完成約50架 CRJ200 的客艙改裝。改裝後每架41席，含7席頭等艙，首架預計於今年底前投入定期航班。
body: 美國支線航空公司 SkyWest 在最新季報中表示，首架改裝後的 CRJ450 預計於2026年底前投入定期航班。這批客機由現有的龐巴迪 CRJ200 改裝，首批將以聯合航空旗下 United Express 品牌營運。
新客艙共有41席。依《The Points Guy》報導，其中7席為頭等艙、16席為加大腿部空間的經濟艙，另外18席為一般經濟艙，機上也規劃設置手提行李櫃和 Starlink Wi-Fi。
SkyWest 預計到2028年完成約50架 CRJ200 改裝。季報另顯示，截至9月底，SkyWest 為聯合航空營運或納入合約的機隊中，共有69架 CRJ200。

en.title: SkyWest expects first 41-seat CRJ450 for United Express by year-end
en.summary: SkyWest plans to convert about 50 CRJ200s by 2028. The CRJ450 configuration will have 41 seats, including seven in first class.
body: SkyWest expects the first CRJ450 to enter scheduled service by the end of 2026, according to its latest quarterly filing. The aircraft is a conversion of the existing Bombardier CRJ200. The first aircraft will operate under the United Express brand.

The Points Guy reported that the new cabin will have seven first-class seats, 16 extra-legroom economy seats and 18 standard economy seats. The configuration also calls for a carry-on luggage closet and Starlink Wi-Fi.
SkyWest expects to complete about 50 conversions by 2028. Its filing lists 69 CRJ200s in scheduled service or under contract for United as of September 30.

zh.title: 阿拉斯加與夏威夷航空機師12月投票 決定首份共同團體協約
zh.summary: 阿拉斯加航空與夏威夷航空機師將於12月1日至22日表決共同團體協約草案，內容包括四年合約及統一薪資架構。
body: 美國航空駕駛員協會（ALPA）公布，阿拉斯加航空與夏威夷航空機師將於12月1日至22日投票，決定是否接受兩家航空公司機師的首份共同團體協約。兩個機師工會執行委員會經過600多天談判，已於11月10日一致同意將草案付諸會員表決。
《Aero Crew News》引述工會協約指南指出，草案效期四年。若獲通過，年資12年的寬體客機機長適用時薪將在2027年訂為493.41美元，到2030年調升至539.16美元。這一薪級適用波音787及空中巴士A330、A330F機隊。
ALPA 指出，阿拉斯加航空執委會代表約3,400名機師，夏威夷航空執委會代表逾1,200人。兩組機師將共同表決，通過後才會適用同一份協約。

en.title: Alaska and Hawaiian pilots to vote on joint contract in December
en.summary: Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines pilots will vote from December 1 to 22 on a proposed four-year joint contract with a common pay structure.
body: The Air Line Pilots Association has scheduled a December 1–22 ratification vote on the first joint contract for Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines pilots. Elected representatives of both pilot groups backed the tentative agreement on November 10 after more than 600 days of negotiations.

Aero Crew News, citing the union’s agreement guide, reported that the four-year proposal sets an hourly rate of $493.41 for a 12-year widebody captain in 2027, rising to $539.16 in 2030. The rate band covers the Boeing 787, Airbus A330 and A330F.
ALPA says the Alaska council represents about 3,400 pilots and the Hawaiian council represents more than 1,200. Both groups will vote on whether to adopt the same agreement.

zh.title: 韓華系統首獲美國雷達訂單 將供應反無人機試點
zh.summary: 南韓韓華系統宣布取得首筆美國雷達訂單，將供應 Rebellion Industries 短程雷達，預計於2027年初交付。
body: 南韓韓華系統（Hanwha Systems）11月18日表示，已與美國防務科技公司 Rebellion Industries 簽約，取得在美國的首筆雷達訂單。韓聯社引述韓華系統指出，這批設備預計於2027年初交付，兩家公司未公布合約金額。
這筆採購屬於試點計畫。韓華將供應短程主動式電子掃描陣列雷達，供雙方開發用於偵測無人機的系統。韓華表示，預期應用包括軍民兩用及關鍵基礎設施防護。

en.title: Hanwha Systems wins first U.S. radar order for a drone-detection pilot
en.summary: South Korea’s Hanwha Systems says it will supply short-range radars to U.S. defense technology company Rebellion Industries by early 2027.
body: South Korea’s Hanwha Systems said on November 18 that it had secured its first U.S. radar order from defense technology company Rebellion Industries. Yonhap, citing Hanwha Systems, reported that delivery was expected by early 2027. The contract value was undisclosed.

The order is part of a pilot project. Hanwha will supply short-range active electronically scanned array radars for a system the companies plan to develop to detect drones. Hanwha identified military and civilian applications, including protection of critical infrastructure.
